body:
# Give Me More Graphics

Give Me More Graphics is a Fabric 1.21.11 visual upgrade modpack focused on atmosphere, foliage, particles, and smooth quality-of-life improvements, while keeping gameplay close to vanilla.

[![Modrinth Profile](https://img.shields.io/badge/Modrinth-thinking__about-1bd96a?logo=modrinth&logoColor=white&style=for-the-badge)](https://modrinth.com/user/thinking_about.)
[![Discord User](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-thinking__about-5865F2?logo=discord&logoColor=white&style=for-the-badge)](https://discord.com)
## What this pack focuses on

- Better visuals without changing core survival progression
- Rich particles, ambient effects, and enhanced environmental feel
- Improved clouds, lighting, and animation polish
- Better menu and UI quality-of-life mods
- Optional shaderpacks included in the modpack for easy switching

## Included visual highlights

- Better clouds and dynamic lighting
- Extra particle and weather effects
- Falling leaves and grass enhancement mods
- Ambient sounds and sound physics improvements
- Entity model and texture enhancement stack
- Zoom support (Zoomify)

## Performance and compatibility

- Built for Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.19.2
- Includes Sodium ecosystem performance stack
- Includes Iris for shader support
- No gameplay cheats included

## Notes

- Shaderpacks are bundled as optional visual presets. Enable one in Video Settings if desired.
- This pack is aimed at visual quality first, with balanced performance.
